overlays.label: SMASH · current reconstruction
overlays.credit: CTIO/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/SMASH/D. Nidever; image processing: Travis Rector, Mahdi Zamani & Davide de Martin
overlays.registrationNote: Current cloud color source. Full 6737 × 6536 image; about 9.35° × 9.07°. Publisher sky coordinates anchor the relative image comparison. The shared saved user-authored model fit (scale 3, +39°, translated about the SMASH pivot) is applied for the Alignment display; it does not establish scientific size or simulated-to-observed star identities. Covers only part of the full simulated stellar field.

overlays.label: ESO VISTA · infrared, star-aligned
overlays.registrationNote: 8954 × 10000 ESO Y/J/Ks image; about 7.7° × 8.6°. Image-to-image scale, rotation and handedness fitted to 16,020 SMASH stars; 5,340 held out, P90 error 0.67 SMASH pixels (~3.3 arcsec), matched hull 83%. Corrected the publisher placement; corners outside the matched hull are extrapolated. The same saved user-authored model fit as SMASH is then applied for display, not as scientific size or simulation registration. Infrared display colors; still partial density coverage. Awaiting approval before cloud processing.

overlays.label: NASA WISE · 24° infrared candidate
overlays.registrationNote: Widest candidate: 6000 × 6000 pixels across 24°, with full pixel coverage. NASA WISE infrared data, display colors by CDS (not visible-light color). ~14.6 arcsec/pixel sampling. Rectangular atlas color/brightness seams cross the LMC: preview only, not approved for cloud processing. FITS orientation verified; independent star-field alignment pending. The shared saved user-authored model fit is applied for display only; it does not validate WISE-to-SMASH or simulation alignment.

overlays.label: DSS2 · 24° wide optical
overlays.credit: Digitized Sky Survey - STScI/NASA, Colored & Healpixed by CDS
overlays.registrationNote: Survey WCS placement across a 24° field. Photographic plate seams, foreground stars and uneven backgrounds remain; use for coverage comparison before reconstruction. This is not calibrated diffuse emission. The same saved image-to-density visual fit is applied as for SMASH. Import and alignment preview only; cloud processing awaits explicit approval.

overlays.label: Horálek · optical wide field
overlays.credit: NOIRLab/NSF/AURA/P. Horálek (Institute of Physics in Opava)
overlays.registrationNote: Measured registration to SMASH using 592 unique point sources; 198 held out of final fit, median 0.59 SMASH pixels and P90 1.12 pixels (4.996 arcsec/pixel). Homography is an approximation; validated point hull covers 60.2% of source raster, outer area extrapolated. No per-pixel distances or simulation correspondence implied. The same saved image-to-density visual fit is applied as for SMASH. Import and alignment preview only; cloud processing awaits explicit approval.

overlays.label: SMASH DR2 · wider optical mosaic
overlays.credit: SMASH survey / D. Nidever et al.; CTIO/NOIRLab/NSF/AURA
overlays.registrationNote: 4111 × 5000 optical mosaic from the SMASH survey team. Wider irregular field footprint; black regions are missing observations, not zero light. 20,661 star matches to current SMASH; 6,887 held out, P90 1.82 SMASH pixels (~9.1 arcsec). Central 30% verified; outer placement extrapolated. Shared saved image-to-density visual fit applied. Visible exposure/field seams retained. Catalogue preview only; no cloud processing.
